reason: User ruled that "today" and day grouping follow the organiser's location, not HKT. The session first hard-coded HKT, then had to redo the work. No existing skill covers Eventar date/zone logic, so the class-level rule goes into a new project skill that later timezone lessons can patch.
A UX-03 test passed at 06:00 and failed after 08:00 local; the fix was to pin the clock, and the trace showed a loosened regex that would hide the wrong sentence.

Cherry-picking the organiser-timezone fix onto a fresh branch hit a signature change: fetchDecoratedEvents gained a 4th `tz` argument. Record the caller set so the next port does not miss the batch tests, which tsc alone may not flag.

The 2026-10-25 organiser-timezone fix was verified by predicting per-zone counts against a fixture spread across one day; the prediction-first check made a server-anchored bug visible. Splitting copy from fix let the user choose the copy separately.

A venue pick silently set the event timezone from a stale search row while the next search loaded. A wrong zone breaks every schedule and check-in window, so the pick must show the zone and stale rows must not be pickable.

A dev-lens review flagged a hydration mismatch in edit-mode time pickers that the dev machine cannot show. The skill covers zone-correct display but not this SSR-versus-browser divergence, so a future session would not know to look for it.
The 2026-11-02 walk found the event form stating the zone twice with conflicting framing; the zone-copy rule for the form is missing from the timezone skill.
